rows.mappingNote: Exact1546380/ようと/用途; intended use or purpose.
rows.sourceNote: Objects and money provide practical examples, not an absolute domain restriction. Use/purpose/function comparisons are direct sense overlaps. Historicalようど monetary entry is not this word.

source.waller_definition: shop which handles Western-style apparel and accessories

rows.mappingNote: Exact1794470/ようひんてん/洋品店; Western-style apparel and related articles shop.
rows.sourceNote: Complete supplemental洋品 public body resolves the principal wrapper's cross-reference. Western-style does not require imported goods or a foreign proprietor. General shop labels overlap without making every retail category a synonym clique.

rows.mappingNote: Exact1662130/ようぶん/養分; nourishment or nutrients.
rows.sourceNote: People, animals and plants are possible; no absolute plants-versus-people distinction from栄養. All primary Han retained even where a component card is absent.

rows.mappingNote: Exact1546530/ようもう/羊毛; sheep's wool.
rows.sourceNote: Material can be raw or in finished garments. Directウール/毛/毛糸 comparisons do not equate a fleece with every pelt or cotton. Useful reciprocal毛 example added.

rows.mappingNote: Same1394600/ようやく; kana-primary recognition of source漸く.
rows.sourceNote: Practical eventual-result and narrow-margin examples plus explicit gradual recognition. Public gradual sense is not conflated with its additional historical slowly sense. No unsupported claim that gradually is obsolete.
rows.identityNote: 漸く is a rarely used kanji form; usually-kana sense information does not create a second lexical identity.

rows.mappingNote: Exact1546850/ようりょう/要領; essentials/gist and knack.
rows.sourceNote: 要領がいい/悪い and要領を得ない explained. Direct outline/gist senses include大体1414470:3 andおよそ1523450:4, not just numerical approximation. Homophone容量 is a different word. Useful reciprocal領 example added.

rows.mappingNote: Exact1547390/よくばり/欲張り; greedy or a greedy person.
rows.sourceNote: Noun/na-adjective with欲ばり recognition. On-first mixed formation storedkango; native張り is not an on reading. Mere desire, stinginess and selfishness are not identical compartments. No speculative history.

rows.mappingNote: Exact1544090/よけい/余計; extra/excess, unwanted/unnecessary and all-the-more.
rows.sourceNote: Attributiveな, degreeに and nonnegative extra provision explained. Completeずっと andオーバー degree/excess comparisons read before drafting. Quantity, evaluation and comparison are not one unrestricted substitution rule.

source.waller_definition: (1) to send,to forward,(2) to hand over (e.g. money)

rows.mappingNote: Exact1013140/よこす; kana-primary send/hand toward speaker plus auxiliary.
rows.sourceNote: 寄越す and rare遣す recognized;寄こす remains search-only. Speakerward viewpoint and blunt register distinguished from often-unwelcome auxiliary nuance, not always-unwelcome or always-favorableくれる rules. Separate historical讒す is excluded.

source.waller_definition: (1) to disgrace,to dishonour,(2) to pollute,to contaminate,to soil,to make dirty,to stain

rows.mappingNote: Exact1178960/よごす/汚す; existing article reused with sourcedN2 added.
rows.sourceNote: Initially added sourced jlpt:2; review also adds a qualified figurative よごす paragraph and dictionary citation. Original identity, title, reading, exclusions, teaching and reciprocal 汚 link retained; raw source and lexical mapping unchanged.
rows.identityNote: よごす is restricted to汚す, not穢す. Disgrace/defile is especiallyけがす, not exclusive. Existing carefully qualified teaching is retained.

source.waller_definition: to collect,to gather,to add,to put aside

rows.mappingNote: Exact1219560/よせる/寄せる; approach/bring/gather/send/add/feelings/temporary reliance/put aside.
rows.sourceNote: Other dictionary senses are qualified recognition. Public intransitive wave construction is distinguished from the pinned family's inherited transitive POS, not silently relabeled. Source collect/gather/add/put-aside gloss retained and taught. Selected senses do not assert every construction has separateN2 status.

rows.mappingNote: Same1605940/よそ; kana-primary recognition of source余所.
rows.sourceNote: Other place, outside own group andNをよそに disregard distinguished, withで/に/の attachment. Direct spatial/social/disregard safeguards are nontransitive, not every social outsider or foreign national.
rows.identityNote: Recognized余所/他所/外 spellings do not merge separate外そと1203250 orほか1203260 identities.

rows.mappingNote: Exact1307060/よつかど/四つ角; four corners and crossroads.
rows.sourceNote: Compoundよつかど has no smallっ despite standalone四つよっつ. Route and paper examples separate senses;四角/四角い shape is not automatically crossroads. Useful reciprocal角 example added.

rows.mappingNote: Exact1372660/よっぱらい/酔っ払い; drunk person and drunkenness.
rows.sourceNote: Noun despite finalい; recognized酔っぱらい. Not necessarily habitual alcoholism and not motion sickness. Primary酔 retained despite absent component card.

rows.mappingNote: Exact1543320/よび/予備; reserve/spare and prior preparation.
rows.sourceNote: 予備の, spare readiness and nonphysical preliminary knowledge/investigation taught. Recognized預備 spelling. Public specialized criminal-law preparation is not required for ordinary practical scope.

source.waller_definition: to call out to,to accost,to address (crowd),to appeal

rows.mappingNote: Exact1266280/よびかける/呼び掛ける; call out/address and appeal/urge.
rows.sourceNote: Ichidan; addresseeに and requested action/cooperationを are explicit. 呼びかける recognized;呼掛ける search-only. Appeal does not entail compliance or every speech/address sense.

rows.mappingNote: Exact1266350/よびだす/呼び出す; summon/call/page and computing invoke/call up.
rows.sourceNote: Transitive godan; personを and destinationに. Public stored-data construction is supported. 開く comparison refers explicitly toひらく file use; the older card's primaryあく identity is not changed.

source.waller_definition: to be resurrected,to be revived,to be resuscitated,to be rehabilitated

rows.mappingNote: Exact1606020/よみがえる/蘇る; revival/restoration and memories returning.
rows.sourceNote: Intransitive godan, not ichidan despiteえる. Recognized甦る and irregular蘇える/甦える do not alter class. Deliberate recall versus memory returning demonstrated; no historical underworld etymology asserted.

rows.mappingNote: Same1606140/よろこび, source rare慶び mapped to retained喜び.
rows.sourceNote: Only rare-spelling recognition added;歓び/悦び also marked rare, without invented rigid emotional partitions.
rows.identityNote: Unrestricted same-family reading/sense supports recognition; shared ID alone is not the proof. Retain primary喜び, N3, title and original teaching.

rows.mappingNote: Same1218760/よろこぶ, source rare慶ぶ mapped to retained喜ぶ.
rows.sourceNote: Raw community gloss is genuinely empty and remains empty. Additional dictionary congratulations/welcome/gladly senses are available evidence, not a compulsory expansion of this easier practical lesson.
